notes.text: The QO-100 resolution requires a directional antenna of at least 21.5 dBi; OpenHamShack does not check the antenna's gain against it.
Modes are free, with bandwidths in line, as a general rule, with the IARU Region 1 band plan.
For EME and meteor scatter, in the IARU sub-bands and outside towns, up to 1000 W PEP may be used; OpenHamShack holds the band's ordinary limit.
Unattended stations: VHF/UHF at most 50 W output outside towns and 10 W inside, antenna at most 6 dBd; HF at most 50 W output.
A portable station must be notified to the Jefatura Provincial five days ahead, except for non-continuous temporary use of up to 15 consecutive days.
